label: Nha Trang
short_description: Loyalty-program beach resorts across Nha Trang and the Cam Ranh coast, from the city beachfront to the Bai Dai resort strip near the airport.
intro: Nha Trang's coverage in this directory runs down the south-central coast of Khanh Hoa province: the city itself, a lively beach town with a long municipal beachfront and an island resort just offshore on Hon Tre; and the Cam Ranh / Bai Dai (Long Beach) strip about 30-40 km south, a newer run of large beach resorts beside Cam Ranh International Airport. City hotels suit shorter, more urban stays; the Cam Ranh resorts suit self-contained beach holidays close to the airport.
